list.name: 组件目录
list.description: 当前 SDK 发行声明的组件，按名称和用途搜索。

detail.name: 组件声明
detail.description: 选中组件在发行里声明的含义、数据、配置、输入、输出和操作签名。

zh-CN.components.section.dataHint: 组件声明的数据：每个数据名要哪种读取结果、是否必需、它自己在运行时会给出哪些读取参数。
zh-CN.components.data.uiOnly: 这个组件不读本体数据，只能当界面用。
zh-CN.components.section.configHint: 组件声明的配置项，超出默认值的由使用它的投影给出。
zh-CN.components.config.none: 这个组件不声明配置项。
zh-CN.components.section.inputHint: 组件声明的取值输入，以及页面可以填入内容的插槽。
zh-CN.components.input.none: 这个组件不声明输入，输入由使用它的投影声明。
zh-CN.components.section.outputHint: 组件交给页面的值（可连到页面的状态），以及它发出的事件。
zh-CN.components.output.declared: 可以连到页面状态的输出值。
zh-CN.components.section.operationsHint: 组件自己声明的操作签名；不显示某个投影实际绑定了哪个业务操作。
zh-CN.components.operations.none: 当前发行没有组件声明操作。页面能执行的操作由投影声明，例如 OperationButton 运行它所在投影声明的操作。
zh-CN.components.table.name: 名称
zh-CN.components.forbidden: 你没有读取这个组件的权限。
zh-CN.components.selectPrompt: 从左侧选择一个组件，查看它在当前发行里声明的各栏。
zh-CN.components.port.binding: 使用它的投影所绑定的对象类型
zh-CN.panel.name: 基础组件

en.components.section.dataHint: The data each datum names: which read results it accepts, whether every placement must supply it, and the read parameters the component supplies at run time.
en.components.data.uiOnly: This component reads no ontology data; it is the interface only.
en.components.section.configHint: The configuration the component declares; a projection that uses it supplies the values beyond these defaults.
en.components.section.inputHint: The typed inputs the component declares, and the slots a page fills with content.
en.components.input.declared: A typed input the component declares.
en.components.slot.declared: A slot the page fills with content.
en.components.input.none: This component declares no inputs; the projection that uses it declares them.
en.components.section.outputHint: The values the component hands the page, bindable to its state, and the events it emits.
en.components.output.declared: An output value bindable to page state.
en.components.section.operationsHint: The operation signatures the component itself declares; which business operation a projection binds is not shown.
en.components.operations.none: No component of the current release declares an operation. A page runs the operations its projections declare, such as OperationButton running the one its projection names.
en.components.table.name: Name
en.components.selectPrompt: Choose a component on the left to read what the current release declares for it.
en.components.port.binding: the object type of the projection that uses it
en.panel.name: Base components
